verdict.rationale: The evidence describes skills, reusable processes Lindy saves and picks automatically when a request calls for one, and routines, which are scheduled or triggered automations. Nothing documents a developer composing a sub-workflow or module that other workflows or routines explicitly call, so skills are only an adjacent feature. Composing callable modules is a fair question for an automation and agent platform like Lindy, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
